No, it's still not clear. I'm not sure what you mean. I'm asking the same thing in the other topic: how to obtain data registered in the registry of [product_name].

Closed because this question was posted twice. The second thread with the subject 'obtain data registered in the registry of [product_name]' was published in the conference for [product_name] - Software. Best regards [user_name]_Moderator
